# QVI — Quality Virtual Instruments

> QVI (getqvi.com) is an audio software studio building on-device AI audio tools. Its core products are QV1 Evaluation, a free Windows app for AI stem separation plus Drum Split (DSP) and mix tools, and Neyora, a DDSP-based instrument synthesis engine that turns text, voice, or MIDI into realistic solo instrument performances (in development). QVI also offers free browser tools (audio, image, PDF, text, QR, and passwords) that process files locally on the user's device — nothing is uploaded. Pages are published in English and in Modern Standard Arabic. Each indexable English URL has an Arabic counterpart under /ar (for example https://getqvi.com/ar and https://getqvi.com/ar/products/qv1). The language control navigates between those URLs.

Note: QVI (getqvi.com, audio software) is unrelated to Quality Vision International (qvii.com, industrial metrology).

## Core products
- [QV1 Evaluation](https://getqvi.com/qv1): Free Windows app for 4 AI stems (third-party, non-commercial) plus Drum Split (DSP), stem editing, and mix tools. Source audio stays on the user's machine. The Windows Setup is a signed-in download of about 170 MB. During install it detects the GPU and downloads components (about 675 MB core, more for NVIDIA CUDA). Model sources and licenses: https://getqvi.com/qv1/models. Product page: https://getqvi.com/products/qv1.
- [Neyora — DDSP Instrument Synthesis](https://getqvi.com/products/neyora): Desktop instrument that renders expressive solo instrument performance from text prompts, sung input, or MIDI using Differentiable DSP. Status: in development. The on-site demo is a placeholder; real synthesis is not available yet.
- [QVI Studio](https://getqvi.com/studio): Free miniature multitrack mixer in the browser (tempo, pitch, metronome, export). Files stay local.

## Free browser tools (no upload, no account)
- [Video to audio, batch (MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, Opus, AIFF, WMA)](https://getqvi.com/tools/mp4-to-mp3)
- [Video converter, batch (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, AVI, GIF)](https://getqvi.com/tools/video-converter)
- [Audio converter, batch (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC, Opus)](https://getqvi.com/tools/mp3-to-wav)
- [Audio cutter, joiner and mixer with fades](https://getqvi.com/tools/audio-cutter)
- [Tempo & pitch changer with tap BPM](https://getqvi.com/tools/tempo-pitch)
- [Image compressor (JPG, PNG, WEBP)](https://getqvi.com/tools/image-compressor)
- [WEBP to JPG converter](https://getqvi.com/tools/webp-to-jpg)
- [Image resizer](https://getqvi.com/tools/image-resizer)
- [Color picker (HEX, RGB, HSL)](https://getqvi.com/tools/color-picker)
- [PNG to PDF](https://getqvi.com/tools/png-to-pdf)
- [PDF compressor](https://getqvi.com/tools/pdf-compressor)
- [PDF merger](https://getqvi.com/tools/pdf-merger)
- [PDF to Word](https://getqvi.com/tools/pdf-to-word)
- [Word & character counter](https://getqvi.com/tools/word-counter)
- [Base64 encode/decode](https://getqvi.com/tools/base64)
- [QR code generator](https://getqvi.com/tools/qr-generator)
- [QR code reader from image](https://getqvi.com/tools/qr-reader)
- [Password generator](https://getqvi.com/tools/password-generator)

## How the free tools work
All processing happens in the browser (FFmpeg.wasm for audio/video, Canvas for images, PDF libraries for PDF, crypto.getRandomValues for passwords). Files are never sent to a QVI server. Free tools may show ads.

## Arabic pages
The same public pages are server-rendered in Arabic at the /ar prefix. Examples:
- https://getqvi.com/ar
- https://getqvi.com/ar/qv1
- https://getqvi.com/ar/qv1/models
- https://getqvi.com/ar/products/qv1
- https://getqvi.com/ar/products/neyora
- https://getqvi.com/ar/studio
- https://getqvi.com/ar/tools
- https://getqvi.com/ar/tools/mp4-to-mp3 (and every other tool and tool category)
- https://getqvi.com/ar/about
- https://getqvi.com/ar/contact
- https://getqvi.com/ar/privacy-policy
- https://getqvi.com/ar/terms

QV1 Evaluation remains a free Windows download. Neyora remains in development. https://getqvi.com/ar/lab permanently redirects to https://getqvi.com/ar/products/neyora.
